Title: TikTok icon is displayed in footer for supported locales
Description: Verify that the TikTok social media icon is visible in the footer for supported locales (Philippines, United States, France, Germany).
Preconditions: User is on the Essilor.com site for a supported locale.
Test Steps: Navigate to the Essilor.com site for Philippines.
Scroll to the footer section.
Verify the TikTok icon is present and ranked #3 after Instagram and before YouTube.
Expected Result: TikTok icon is visible in the footer and positioned correctly.

Title: TikTok icon redirects to Essilor TikTok account in new tab
Description: Verify that clicking the TikTok icon in the footer opens the Essilor TikTok account in a new browser tab.
Preconditions: User is on the Essilor.com site for a supported locale and TikTok icon is visible in the footer.
Test Steps: Navigate to the Essilor.com site for United States.
Scroll to the footer section.
Click the TikTok icon.
Expected Result: Essilor TikTok account (https://www.tiktok.com/@essilor) opens in a new browser tab.

Title: TikTok icon is not displayed in footer for unsupported locales
Description: Verify that the TikTok social media icon is not visible in the footer for unsupported locales (India, China, Taiwan, Hongkong).
Preconditions: User is on the Essilor.com site for an unsupported locale.
Test Steps: Navigate to the Essilor.com site for India.
Scroll to the footer section.
Verify the TikTok icon is not present.
Expected Result: TikTok icon is not visible in the footer.

Title: TikTok icon is ranked #3 in social media icons list
Description: Verify that the TikTok icon is positioned as the third icon in the social media icons list in the footer, after Instagram and before YouTube, for supported locales.
Preconditions: User is on the Essilor.com site for a supported locale.
Test Steps: Navigate to the Essilor.com site for France.
Scroll to the footer section.
Verify the order of social media icons: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube.
Expected Result: TikTok icon is ranked #3 in the social media icons list.

Title: TikTok icon opens correct URL
Description: Verify that clicking the TikTok icon opens the correct Essilor TikTok account URL (https://www.tiktok.com/@essilor).
Preconditions: User is on the Essilor.com site for a supported locale and TikTok icon is visible in the footer.
Test Steps: Navigate to the Essilor.com site for Germany.
Scroll to the footer section.
Click the TikTok icon.
Verify the opened URL is https://www.tiktok.com/@essilor.
Expected Result: TikTok icon opens the correct Essilor TikTok account URL.

Title: TikTok icon does not open in same tab
Description: Verify that clicking the TikTok icon does not redirect the user in the same tab but opens a new tab instead.
Preconditions: User is on the Essilor.com site for a supported locale and TikTok icon is visible in the footer.
Test Steps: Navigate to the Essilor.com site for Philippines.
Scroll to the footer section.
Click the TikTok icon.
Verify the Essilor TikTok account opens in a new tab and the original site remains open.
Expected Result: Essilor TikTok account opens in a new tab, original site remains open.

Title: TikTok icon is not clickable for unsupported locales
Description: Verify that the TikTok icon is not clickable or present for unsupported locales (India, China, Taiwan, Hongkong).
Preconditions: User is on the Essilor.com site for an unsupported locale.
Test Steps: Navigate to the Essilor.com site for China.
Scroll to the footer section.
Verify the TikTok icon is not present or clickable.
Expected Result: TikTok icon is not present or clickable for unsupported locales.

Title: Footer layout remains consistent after TikTok icon addition
Description: Verify that the addition of the TikTok icon does not disrupt the footer layout for supported locales.
Preconditions: User is on the Essilor.com site for a supported locale.
Test Steps: Navigate to the Essilor.com site for United States.
Scroll to the footer section.
Verify the footer layout remains consistent and visually correct after TikTok icon addition.
Expected Result: Footer layout remains consistent and visually correct.
